title: The Dark Side of AI Every Parent Needs to Know | Doug Fiafia
summary: Jeff Mann interviews Utah State Representative Doug Fiafia about AI regulation, liability and children’s safety, including AI companions and parental involvement. The wider conversation also covers identity, politics and family.

moments.label: Parental involvement in children’s AI use

title: The Cost of Knowledge: Paying in Data – Surveillance, AI and the Future of Open Access
summary: A panel on surveillance and data extraction in research, publishing and learning platforms, covering intellectual privacy, academic freedom, Indigenous knowledge and community-governed infrastructure.

title: AI Innovation with Guardrails: Utah Commissioner Margaret Busse in Conversation
summary: Utah Commerce Commissioner Margaret Woolley Busse discusses the state’s AI policy approach, including its regulatory sandbox, mental-health chatbots, deepfakes and keeping AI accountable to people.
